title: Annual report.
bodyText: The public guardian shall prepare and submit an annual report to the chief justice and render such other reports as the chief justice may from time to time require.
bodyHtml: [§551A-7]  Annual report.  The public guardian shall prepare and submit an annual report to the chief justice and render such other reports as the chief justice may from time to time require. [L 1984, c 223, pt of §1]
